name: Elad Software Systems
summary: Operating out of Israel, Elad Software Systems Ltd. delivers a comprehensive suite of information technology solutions, services, and expert consulting and management guidance. Its offerings include 'Chameleon,' a specialized electronic medical record (EMR) system tailored for hospitals and other medical facilities. Additionally, the company develops various customer relationship management (CRM), digital, and web-based platforms, alongside robust business intelligence (BI) tools and data-driven management solutions. Beyond its software products, Elad extends its expertise through training courses offered via its Netcraft Academy. Further complementing its portfolio are essential services like system maintenance, technical support, IT outsourcing, and a range of professional services. The company serves a broad spectrum of clients across numerous industries, encompassing banking, transportation, healthcare, retail, insurance, technology, industrial, media, public administration, and real estate sectors, as well as government entities. Founded in 1982, Elad Software maintains its headquarters in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel.
